cover_headline: Navdeep Bains Wins Ontario Liberal Leadership on Final Ballot, 50.3 to 49.7
facts: Navdeep Bains was elected leader of the Ontario Liberal Party on November 21, 2026, beating Lee Fairclough 50.3 per cent to 49.7 per cent on the third and final ballot
Bains is the first visible minority to lead the Ontario Liberal Party
20,510 party members voted in the leadership contest

quote.text: This may be the end of a leadership race, ladies and gentlemen, but this is just the beginning of our campaign to replace Doug Ford and the Conservative Party of Ontario.
quote.speaker: Navdeep Bains

end.headline: Navdeep Bains Wins Ontario Liberal Leadership on Final Ballot, 50.3 to 49.7
end.line: The former federal industry minister from Mississauga beat MPP Lee Fairclough by less than a point after a nine-month race, and now has to rebuild a party that holds 14 seats.
